metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1998 · Kirikou and the Sorceress
metas.description: Kirikou, an unusual little boy, must search the wisdom of the forbidden mountain in order to save his village from a spell cast by the evil sorceress Karaba

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1995 · The Cure
metas.description: Erik, a loner, finds a friend in Dexter, an eleven-year-old boy with AIDS. They vow to find a cure for AIDS together and save Dexter's life in an eventful summer.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1997 · The Batman Superman Movie: World's Finest
metas.description: Joker goes to Metropolis with an offer and plan to kill Superman for Lex Luthor while Batman pursues the clown to Superman's turf.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1995 · A Chinese Odyssey: Part 2 - Cinderella
metas.description: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1995 · A Chinese Odyssey: Part One - Pandora's Box
metas.description: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1992 · And Life Goes On
metas.description: A director and his son return to a region damaged by the Guilan earthquake, hoping to find the children who appeared in his film a few years earlier.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1998 · Babylon 5: In the Beginning
metas.description: Emperor Londo Mollari of the Centauri Republic tells the story of the Earth-Minbari War that almost destroyed humanity and later inspired its last best, hope for peace.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1990 · My Father's Glory
metas.description: At the end of the nineteenth century, little Marcel lives with his parents in the Provence countryside. During his holiday, Marcel meets Lili, a local boy who knows all the secrets of the hills, and the two become fast friends.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1998 · Horatio Hornblower: The Duel
metas.description: Horatio Hornblower begins his naval career, but a deadly feud with a despicable mate is causing complications.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1990 · My Mother's Castle
metas.description: Every holiday Marcel and his family go to their cottage near Marseilles. During one of these holidays he meets Isabelle, a pretty but conceited girl... Adapted from the cult classic novel from Marcel Pagnol.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1992 · Yoddha
metas.description: Fate brings a young man from rural Kerala to be the protector of a young Lama in Nepal, who is being chased by a dangerous cult.
